tactics: intro α xs h <;> cases xs with | nil => simp at h | cons x xs => cases xs <;> simp_all [List.dropLast]
intro α xs h <;> match xs, h with | [], h => simp at h | [_], h => simp at h | _ :: _ :: _, _ => rfl
intro α xs h <;> rcases xs with _ | ⟨a, _ | ⟨b, l⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
intro α xs h <;> cases xs <;> simp_all
